subprocess_flow.description: Assess the incoming AI model use case, architectural profile, and risk tiering to determine the required audit evaluation pathway. For qualified minimal-risk internal automation tools, initiate an expedited delegated quality assurance audit track to alleviate auditor capacity constraints, while directing bespoke high-risk models, third-party COTS APIs, and Generative AI systems into full specialist ethical audit tracks.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Independent Model Auditor / Quality Assurance Lead
success_criteria: Accurate routing to either delegated low-risk QA track or specialist ethical audit pipeline
Delegated Minimal-Risk Audit Determination recorded for qualified systems within 2 business days
Clear scoping baseline established for downstream bias, explainability, or empirical LLM testing
subprocess_flow.purpose: Establish calibrated audit pathways to alleviate specialist auditor capacity bottlenecks while maintaining rigorous oversight for high-risk judicial tools.
subprocess_flow.scope: All registered AI initiatives passing security baseline review across bespoke ML, COTS SaaS, and GenAI models.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Receipt of security clearance and finalized model training validation outputs or COTS API staging access
end_conditions: Approval and recording of audit routing determination, allowing either delegated closure or full audit progression

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Incorrect designation of a high-impact judicial AI model as minimal-risk
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated verification against statutory high-risk use case registries and dual sign-off requirement for any delegated audit qualification

governance_requirements: EU AI Act High-Risk System Requirements (Articles 9-15)
Central Digital and Data Office ATRS Ethical Guidelines

change_management.change_request_process: Appeals or re-evaluations of audit track assignment submitted via Enterprise Architecture review ticket
change_management.versioning_rules: Audit determination records stamped with git commit hash and semver

subprocess_flow.description: Execute statistical parity checks, disparate impact analysis, and demographic performance comparisons across protected characteristics defined under the Equality Act 2010. Evaluate predictive error parity (false positive and false negative balance) to ensure that decision support models do not disadvantage vulnerable cohorts in justice, probation, or court contexts.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Independent Model Auditor / Quality Assurance Lead
success_criteria: Disparate impact ratio meets statutory thresholds (0.80 to 1.25 parity rule) across protected classes
Equalized odds and demographic parity metrics thoroughly evaluated and documented
Zero open unmitigated critical demographic bias findings
subprocess_flow.purpose: Verify quantitative fairness, prevent unlawful disparate impact, and ensure adherence to Public Sector Equality Duties.
subprocess_flow.scope: Bespoke predictive algorithms, tabular decision-support tools, and supervised machine learning pipelines.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Assignment of model to specialist statistical audit track
end_conditions: Generation and auditor sign-off of Disparate Impact & Bias Evaluation Matrix

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Systemic bias against protected demographic cohorts resulting in discriminatory sentencing or probation recommendations
step_risks_and_controls.control: Enforcement of automated multi-metric fairness suites (AIF360, Fairlearn) with mandatory 80-125% parity tolerance gating

governance_requirements: UK National AI Strategy Ethical Principles
EU AI Act Article 10 (Data and Data Governance)

change_management.change_request_process: Fairness threshold waivers or regularisation retraining logged in MLOps model registry
change_management.versioning_rules: Evaluation matrices versioned with semver tied to model artifact hash

improvement_inputs: Fairness metric distributions across justice deployments

subprocess_flow.description: Perform empirical input-output behavioral testing, toxicity evaluation, and hallucination rate benchmarking for Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) algorithms and Generative AI/LLM applications where underlying training sets and model weights are proprietary. Validate vendor-provided model cards against empirical red-teaming datasets to verify that generative answers remain truthful, safe, and free from abusive or toxic responses.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Independent Model Auditor / Quality Assurance Lead
inputs: Empirical Test Prompts and Behavioral Datasets
success_criteria: 100% resolution or mitigation of critical hallucination, jailbreak, or toxic response vectors
Vendor model card claims corroborated by empirical benchmarking tests
Hallucination rate constrained below pre-defined operational safety tolerance thresholds
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide robust empirical assurance for black-box COTS and GenAI systems lacking open white-box access to weights or training pipelines.
subprocess_flow.scope: Third-party Foundation Models, SaaS AI integrations, Large Language Models, and proprietary vendor APIs.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Availability of COTS API staging sandbox or Generative AI inference deployment
end_conditions: Formal auditor approval of Black-Box & GenAI Ethical Evaluation Dossier

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Generative AI produces legally invalid advice, hallucinates case law, or generates toxic responses
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated prompt injection testing, adversarial red-teaming evaluation suites (e.g., Giskard, NeMo), and factual ground-truth benchmark assertions

governance_requirements: CDDO ATRS Ethical Guidelines for Generative AI
UK National AI Strategy Ethical Principles
OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications

change_management.change_request_process: Prompt template enhancements and vendor API endpoint revisions tracked via GitOps configuration repos
change_management.versioning_rules: Evaluation benchmark suites tagged and hashed alongside prompt manifests

subprocess_flow.description: Analyze local and global interpretability using feature attribution frameworks (SHAP, LIME, Captum) for predictive models, and retrieval citation tracing for Generative AI architectures. Ensure that operational justice practitioners, probation caseworkers, and legal representatives can review, understand, and contest the primary variables influencing automated outputs.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Independent Model Auditor / Quality Assurance Lead
success_criteria: Feature attribution fidelity verified against domain subject matter expertise
Explanations rendered into plain-language summaries consumable by non-technical judicial caseworkers
Global feature rankings confirm absence of illegal proxy variables
subprocess_flow.purpose: Ensure algorithmic recommendations are legally interpretable, explainable, and contestable under UK public administrative law.
subprocess_flow.scope: Feature attributions, surrogate models, decision rationale displays, and retrieval source citation chains.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Completion of empirical fairness and black-box behavioral assessments
end_conditions: Delivery and auditor sign-off of the Explainability Assessment Dossier

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Opaque black-box models producing uninterpretable decisions, precluding effective legal appeals
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory extraction and validation of local SHAP/LIME explanation vectors or verifiable source citations for every inference class

governance_requirements: CDDO Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS Tier 2)

change_management.change_request_process: Explainability threshold modifications reviewed by MoJ AI Technical Review Panel
change_management.versioning_rules: Explainability dossiers cryptographically signed and stored with model version reference

improvement_inputs: Explainability feedback from legal and operational caseworkers

subprocess_flow.description: Establish operational human-in-the-loop protocols, manual override workflows, and caseworker escalation pathways to protect against automation bias. Synthesize the results from demographic parity evaluations, black-box empirical audits, explainability assessments, or delegated minimal-risk determinations into the final MoJ Ethical AI Conformance Report and Independent Model Audit Report.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Independent Model Auditor / Quality Assurance Lead
success_criteria: 100% resolution or documented risk acceptance of all model bias, toxicity, and opacity findings
Operational caseworker override procedures documented with mandatory audit logging
Independent auditor endorsement and digital cryptographic sign-off completed
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide final independent validation of ethical alignment and ensure meaningful human oversight before stage-gate board submission.
subprocess_flow.scope: Human-in-the-loop operational procedures, final synthesized ethical dossiers, and independent audit attestations.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Completion of explainability dossier and consolidation of all technical assessment outputs
end_conditions: Independent auditor endorsement and sign-off of fairness and explainability report, or delegated audit sign-off for low-risk systems

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Automation bias causing human operators to passively rubber-stamp algorithmic recommendations without due diligence
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory documented rationale captured in case management tools for both accepting and overriding AI recommendations, supplemented by random human review audits

governance_requirements: UK National AI Strategy Ethical Principles on Accountability

change_management.change_request_process: Remediation requests for audit non-conformance submitted to MLOps registry and tracked in Jira/ServiceNow
change_management.versioning_rules: Final audit certificates signed with PKI digital signature and archived for 7-year retention

improvement_inputs: Feedback from judicial and operational oversight bodies
